title: The Crown of the Glass Steppe
author: Zephyrine Almeida
blurb: August Okafor, a mercenary sworn to a god that went silent, has never left the valley where magic cannot follow. But when a dying stranger presses a map into unwilling hands, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must unbind a king from the thing wearing his crown before the long winter finishes falling.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
